GARLAND, TX (Oct 14, 2026) — Massimo is advancing a new retail program to bring its products to more Ace Hardware stores. Massimo already sells through a number of independently operated Ace locations and is now working to offer programs to Ace retailers more widely.


Massimo recently presented its powersports lineup and retail programs to Ace representatives and store owners at an Ace Hardware event in Orlando, Florida. Ace operates more than 5,000 stores across the United States.


"Working with individual Ace stores has already demonstrated to us that there is a natural fit between the Ace customer and Massimo's product portfolio," said Quenton Petersen, CEO of Massimo Group. "Ace has an extraordinary network of locally owned stores, including many locations serving rural, outdoor and recreational markets that align well with our customer base."
